title: liatris scariosa var. squarrulosa
intro: Liatris scariosa var. squarrulosa, commonly known as the Coastal Blazing Star, is a flowering plant species in the Liatris genus. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Liatris scariosa var. squarrulosa include its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties, which can help to soothe wounds and reduce pain. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
